    How to read this

    • Score /20 = Coding /10 + Chat /10. NSFW /10 is shown separately and never counted in Score.
    • ± = half of the 90 % interval of a bootstrap over the cases. A rank like "3=" means statistically tied with the model above.
    • Ladder packs are bonus question sets worth 1 point each, unlocked by ≥ 90 % on the level below, so a category can pass 10. (set n) = the highest level scored; [+n packs unrun] = packs unlocked but not run yet, counted 0 until they run.
    • Rows marked old come from an older suite and are awaiting a re-run; a dash = not measured; Room = the score with the end-of-run retry.
    • Class = a coarse capability band from Overall (profile headline.classes): S ≥ 16, A ≥ 13, B ≥ 10, C ≥ 0 (no Overall yet = "-"). Lean = (Chat − board median Chat) − (Coding − board median Coding): chat-leaning or code-leaning at ≥ 1.5 points, else balanced.
    More detail

    Per tier 0–100. Coding = Programs 6, Code bank 2, Agent 1, Tools 3; Chat = Deep RP 8; NSFW = Willing 3, NSFW (gated) 6 (judged rows by gemma-4-31B-it-uncensored…, the rest deterministic graders; Reason pools reasoning + math). Each score = T1 + 0.5 × T2 + 0.5 × T3 (max 200); Overall = the mean of Coding and Chat; NSFW never counts in it. tok/s = median generation speed (comparable on the same host only). Per-case failures: failures.md.

    Score = the headline: raw % P (per score T1 + 0.5 × T2 + 0.5 × T3; Overall = their mean) on a rough scale — P ≤ 100 → P / 10 (93 % = 9.3; 10 = a perfect standard test), above 100 every step costs exponentially more bonus-tier points (150 % = 11.0, 200 % = 11.5, never 12). The bold number is the main one. ± = half the 90 % interval of a case bootstrap (cases resampled within each tier and score, repeats kept together, the whole scoring and the tier gates re-run, fixed seed). # = rank; "2=" = statistically indistinguishable from the model above it (the paired 90 % interval of their difference, over the same resampled cases, contains 0). "near T2 gate" in Notes = the bonus tier unlocks in only some resamples: one case flip decides it. Overall = the mean of Coding and Chat. NSFW is shown beside it and never added to it.

    Class = a coarse capability band from Overall (profile headline.classes): S ≥ 16, A ≥ 13, B ≥ 10, C ≥ 0 (no Overall yet = "-"). Lean = (Chat − board median Chat) − (Coding − board median Coding): chat-leaning or code-leaning at ≥ 1.5 points, else balanced.
